decisions.reason: The product extends the firm's core secure communication capability, so the option remains cheap to keep while uncertainty is still high.
Digital signature is a natural adjacent use of the firm's authentication know-how, and early market signals are still too uncertain to justify dropping.
As a foundational architecture, it holds option value for multiple future offerings and is low-cost to keep relative to its strategic importance.
The email-to-app robot is more peripheral and has a higher cost to keep than other options, but it is still too early to abandon.
Hardware tokens carry higher inventory and support costs, raising the probability of dropping, yet the option value of QR-based signing remains open.
Payment compliance fits strong regulatory demand and the firm's existing security suite, making it a valuable option to keep.
